run_GTestFilterUnitTest: run the GTestFilterUnitTest suite to verify gtest_filter flag and environment variable filtering behavior
test_GTestFilterUnitTest_testDefaultBeha: test the default behavior of googletest-filter-unittest when no filter is specified via RunAndVerify
test_GTestFilterUnitTest_testEmptyFilter: test that an empty gtest_filter string results in no tests being run
test_GTestFilterUnitTest_testNegativeFil: test negative filter patterns like *-BazTest.TestOne to exclude specific tests from the run set
test_GTestFilterUnitTest_testShardingWor: test that test sharding works correctly with death tests using RunAndVerifyWithSharding
